locations.title: Target Locations / Cities
locations.description: List of cities or locations to analyze (e.g. ['Casablanca', 'Tokyo', 'New York', 'Riyadh']).

includeAirQuality.title: Include Air Quality (AQI & Pollutants)
includeAirQuality.description: Fetch PM2.5, PM10, NO2, O3, and European AQI.

includeMarineWeather.title: Include Marine / Wave Telemetry
includeMarineWeather.description: Fetch significant wave height, swell period, and sea direction.

includeSpaceWeather.title: Include Space Weather & Solar Activity
includeSpaceWeather.description: Fetch NOAA solar flare classification, radio blackout risk, and planetary geomagnetic Kp index.

includeEarthquakes.title: Include Live USGS Seismic Activity
includeEarthquakes.description: Fetch live earthquakes worldwide with magnitude and tectonic plate identification.

apiKey.title: Apify API Token / Custom Key
apiKey.description: Optional Apify API token or custom authentication key for MCP and programmatic triggers.
